explanation: Gold was found in Minas Gerais in the 1690s by men who had walked there, and what turned a find into a cycle was that half a million enslaved Africans could be brought to the region to work it — against some four hundred thousand Portuguese. The traffic was already running and already organised when the strikes happened, which is why the type is `enabled` rather than `caused`: it did not put the gold in the ground or send anyone to look for it, but a mining economy on that scale was not available to a colony that had to recruit its miners.
